page.overview:
Who is The Glutton?

The Glutton commanded a base in Khidr's Shadow, where he developed a terrifying reputation as a cannibal who ate his victims while they were still alive.

The Glutton entered his dining room and began to eat one of his victims. He smelled an intruder and called out to them. He told them that they should have washed themself in blood laced with chaumas. He explained that his hunger was unnatural and controlled him. He asked them if they had a similar experience of being controlled by something they could not define. He then attacked them, but was ultimately overpowered and killed.
